limits: Host simulation and static artifacts do not qualify APK, handset or RF behavior.
objective: Controlled endpoint nonce round-trip over ordinary UDP with bounded single request.
required: Two owned endpoints and documented endpoint IPs
Receiver starts first using same fresh 256-bit nonce
Timeout <=10 seconds, one send per invocation
Record route tables, interface identifiers, AP topology and forwarding evidence separately
success: Matching nonce proves endpoint round-trip; silence is unknown and never proves isolation.
stop_gate: No direct-versus-forwarded classification without independent route/AP evidence; harness always returns path unknown.
